evidence.quote: Bay two gets the pilot unit first

observations.why: Installation is a planned future action in present-tense grammar, so the stance is irrealis; the bays and pilot unit are particular referents, so construal is concrete.
A bare ratification that settles the present exchange; attention is on the current state of agreement, which is actual.

evidence.quote: The sensors report every fifteen minutes
anything slower misses the overnight drop

observations.why: Habitual present describes the actual device behavior, and the second clause states a general principle about any slower interval, so construal is abstract.
